# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 22 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**22:1** [...] the-wicked [...] in their error they have walked [...] and they did not heed [...]

**22:2** [...] they have turned-aside from the-way-of Your heart, and [...] their abominations [...]

**22:3** [...] in the-stubbornness-of their heart they have wandered, and [...] they have sought You not [...]

**22:4** [...] and they did not choose that which You desire, and they have not hearkened [...]

**22:5** [...] they have gathered-together against Your covenant, and the-men-of Your counsel [...]

**22:6** [...] they have spoken against You with a tongue-of insolence, and they have not [...]

**22:7** [...] their lips-of deceit, for they are not established in Your truth [...]

**22:8** [...] and in their heart they devise plans-of Belial, and they seek You with a double heart [...]

**22:9** [...] they are not established in Your truth, and a root bearing-poison [...] is in their designs,

**22:10** [...] and in the-stubbornness-of their heart they wander, and they seek You through idols [...]

**22:11** [...] You opened [the-ear-of] the-dust to Your truth and [...] You have instructed [...]

**22:12** [...] for You know every purpose-of action, and every reply-of the-tongue You discern,

**22:13** [...] You have established their heart by Your [...] and by Your understanding [...]

**22:14** [...] that they might be guarded from sinning, and [...] that they might turn from all [...]

**22:15** [...] and You have chastened them in the-mysteries-of Your wonder, and for-the-sake-of Your glory [...]

**22:16** [...] You have opened their ears that they may hear [...] marvelous things [...]

**22:17** [...] for the-sake-of Your name You have acted, to make-great [...] the-truth [...]

**22:18** [...] and to establish the-men-of Your counsel in the-midst-of the-sons-of Adam [...]

**22:19** [...] to recount Your wonders to-all generations, and in Your mighty-deeds [...]

**22:20** [...] the tongue that You have formed has not returned from its stubbornness [...]

**22:21** [...] but it has spoken iniquity, and the-fruit-of their scheming [...] they have not [...]

**22:22** [...] and they have hardened their heart, and they have not turned in Your ways [...]

**22:23** [...] their soul has rejected the-instruction-of knowledge, and truth they have not held-fast [...]

**22:24** [...] and You have hidden Your face from them, and Your [...] they have not [...]

**22:25** [...] for they have despised Your statutes, and their soul has not delighted [...]

**22:26** [...] they have walked in the-stubbornness-of their heart and have not sought [...]

**22:27** [...] their guilt is exceedingly great, and [...] in the-fire [...]

**22:28** [...] and You have removed them from Your covenant, and all their works [...]

**22:29** [...] in Your wrath You have judged them, and [...] with fury [...]

**22:30** [...] and You cast the-wicked into the-fire, consuming for eternity,

**22:31** [...] and all the-men-of deceit shall be no more, and the-workers-of wickedness [...]

**22:32** [...] for Your judgment is righteous, and none can stand before Your wrath [...]

**22:33** [...] and Your truth endures for-all generations, and all [...]

**22:34** [...] for eternity and ever [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 22 is fragmentary but thematically cohesive, contrasting the wicked who persist in stubbornness with God's righteous judgment. "Stubbornness of heart" (sherirut lev) is a key Qumran phrase recurring throughout the column. Construct chains preserved with hyphens. Lacunae reflect genuine manuscript damage.*
